abstract: We report herein the case of a 30-year-old man who developed a primary leiomyosarcoma (LMS) 11 years after undergoing a median sternotomy for mediastinal seminoma followed by 50 Gy radiotherapy. He was given two courses of chemotherapy, resulting in 90% tumor regression, after which resection of the tumor with adjacent chest wall structures was carried out. Reconstruction was performed using a methylmethacrylate prosthesis prepared preoperatively. Postoperatively, he received two additional courses of chemotherapy and has had no sign of recurrence for 45 months.
abstract_ja: 縦隔セミノーマに対して正中切開術と50Gyの放射線療法を受けた11年後に、原発性平滑筋肉腫を発症した30歳男性の症例を報告する。化学療法を2コース施行したところ腫瘍は90%縮小し、その後、隣接する胸壁構造とともに腫瘍を切除した。術前に作製したメチルメタクリレート製人工物を用いて再建した。術後にさらに2コースの化学療法を受け、45か月間再発の徴候はない。
